## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] One change in this pull request (one tool, one fix or one feature)
- [ ] I tried it on my own machine, and I understand every line, including lines an AI assistant wrote
- [ ] For a new tool: `sideby plugins check <id>` passes, and I followed "Adding a family" in `AGENTS.md`
- [ ] English and Chinese docs are updated together, when user-facing behavior or wording changes
- [ ] No secrets: no tokens, `proxy.env`, `auth.json`, `.claude.json` values
- [ ] No personal details: real account names, emails, home paths, hostnames, ports or names of my own tools are replaced by `claude:work`, `me@example.com`, port 17420 and the like
